properties.name: grpc.server.port
properties.description: Port for the gRPC Netty server.

properties.name: grpc.server.auth-token
properties.description: Shared service token every gRPC call must present as x-service-token. Unset leaves the server fail-closed, rejecting every call.

properties.name: movie-service.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for movie-service candidate fetching.

properties.name: speech-to-text.vosk.model-path
properties.description: Local filesystem path to the English Vosk offline voice model.

properties.name: speech-to-text.vosk.model-path-de
properties.description: Local filesystem path to the German Vosk offline voice model.
